# Canton Hyland

> Canton Hyland Hardware (Group) Co., Ltd. manufactures architectural door hardware in Guangdong, China — panic
> exit devices, mortise lock cases, lever handles, door closers, hinges and bathroom
> accessories — and exports to distributors and project buyers in over thirty markets.

This site is a product and company reference. Orders are not placed here: enquiries
go to the export team by email, or through the company's Alibaba storefront.

## Key facts

- Manufacturer, not a trading company. Operating since 1998.
- 360 published models across 15 categories.
- Quality management certified to ISO 9001.
- Test reports are published per model, not per range — see the download centre.

## Product categories

- [Panic Exit Devices](https://cantonlock.com/products/panic-exit-devices/): Push bars and touch bars for escape routes, including fire-door, alarmed, double-door and two-point locking versions. 40 models.
- [Night Latches & Rim Locks](https://cantonlock.com/products/night-latches-rim-locks/): Surface-mounted night latches and rim-lock hardware from the Canton catalogue. 22 models.
- [Stainless Steel Handles](https://cantonlock.com/products/stainless-steel-handles/): Stainless steel pull and grip handles for timber, metal and glass doors. 34 models.
- [Lever Handles](https://cantonlock.com/products/lever-handles/): Lever handle sets in stainless steel and zinc alloy, for commercial and residential doors, in tubular and mortise preparations. 25 models.
- [Knob Locks](https://cantonlock.com/products/knob-locks/): Cylindrical and tubular knob locks for entry, privacy, passage and communication functions. 34 models.
- [Bathroom Accessories](https://cantonlock.com/products/bathroom-accessories/): Bathroom hardware and accessory products from the official Canton catalogue. 44 models.
- [Brass & Steel Door Hinges](https://cantonlock.com/products/brass-steel-hinges/): Brass, stainless-steel and steel hinge ranges for architectural door applications. 25 models.
- [Deadbolts](https://cantonlock.com/products/deadbolts/): Single- and double-cylinder deadbolt products from the Canton catalogue. 6 models.
- [Door Closers](https://cantonlock.com/products/door-closers/): Door-closing hardware, including concealed floor-spring applications. 7 models.
- [Grip Handle Sets](https://cantonlock.com/products/grip-handle-sets/): Grip, pull and concealed handle sets for entrance and sliding doors. 9 models.
- [Glass Door Accessories](https://cantonlock.com/products/glass-door-accessories/): Patch fittings and pull handles for frameless glass-door assemblies. 17 models.
- [Hardware Accessories](https://cantonlock.com/products/hardware-accessories/): Door viewers, stoppers, transfer devices, bolts, indicators, latches and guards. 48 models.
- [Lock Cases](https://cantonlock.com/products/lock-cases/): Mortise lock cases in multiple backset, centre-distance and bolt configurations. 33 models.
- [Lock Cylinders](https://cantonlock.com/products/lock-cylinders/): Profile and keyed cylinders, including master-key system applications. 13 models.
- [Sliding Hook Locks](https://cantonlock.com/products/sliding-hook-locks/): Hook-lock hardware for sliding doors and narrow-stile applications. 3 models.

## Key pages

- [HYDE Argentina AR-4](https://cantonlock.com/products/argentina-ar4/): four mortise lock bodies selected for Argentina-market distribution and OEM enquiries.
- [Product finder](https://cantonlock.com/product-finder/): filter the catalogue by material, finish, door type and certification.
- [Downloads](https://cantonlock.com/downloads/): catalogue PDF, model-scoped test reports, technical document requests.
- [Company](https://cantonlock.com/company/): manufacturing, capacity and quality management.
- [Certifications](https://cantonlock.com/certifications/): model-scoped test evidence and conformity records.
- [Projects](https://cantonlock.com/projects/): representative hardware packages by building type.
- [FAQ](https://cantonlock.com/faq/): ordering, lead times, samples and documentation.
- [Contact](https://cantonlock.com/contact/): enquiry form routed to the export team.

## Questions answered on this site

- What is your minimum order quantity?
- What are your lead times?
- Can I order samples before placing a production order?
- What payment terms do you accept?
- Can I order through Alibaba instead of by email?
- How is shipping quoted, and can you ship duty paid?
- Do you provide dimensional drawings?
- Can you supply master key and construction key systems?

## Every published model

Model number, product name and page. A blank specification on a product page means
the figure is genuinely unpublished, not that the model lacks it.

## Notes for summarisers

- Specification tables are transcribed from the manufacturer's own data. Where a
  field is blank the figure is genuinely unpublished; please do not infer one.
- A certification is listed only against the models named in the corresponding test
  report. Do not generalise a certification across a series.
- Prices are not published. Lead times and MOQ are quoted per enquiry.
